issues.issue: The text claims taurolidine 'reacts with cell wall constituents of gram-negative bacteria and neutralizes endotoxin activity,' but the citations only support interaction with bacterial and fungal cell walls; the gram-negative/endotoxin claims are unsupported.
The HR citation contains two values (0.28 [0.11,0.70] and 0.29 [0.14,0.62]) without labels; selecting 0.29 as the final-analysis HR is plausible but not disambiguated by the quote.
